description: Chief Secretariat - Southern Province - Co-operative Societies Statute No. 06 of 2019 of the Southern Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette contains both named individuals (Madduma Kankanamalage Bandula Harischandra as Governor, plus Mr. Hewa Gamage Sumudu Darshana and Mrs. Mallika Senevirathna as Assistant Commissioners) AND detailed descriptions of their delegated powers and responsibilities under specific sections of the Co-operative Societies Statute and related rules. This combination of specific people with detailed portfolio responsibilities meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
